git add crates/elephc-builtin-contract tests/builtin_parity_tests.rs && git commit -m "test(contract): the surface counters and the prelude set learn dir()

dir() is the sixth prelude-implemented contract and has no eval implementation
yet, so five pins move by one: contracts 555, eval_pending 32, aot_external 11,
unsupported eval routes 71, and the exceptional-surface list gains its name —
the exact counter family the ten-builtin landing moved last time. Red on all
three CI platforms in run 31884159099; contract crate 15/15 and parity 5/5
green after." 2>&1 | tail -1; git rev-parse HEAD~1
